title: The Slag Golem
text: A golem of cooled slag sits on a heap, its body pitted and black, its eyes two glowing coals. It is humming a work song very slowly. It wants a job, it says; it has not had one in a hundred years.

options.label: Give the golem a job; a hundred years is long enough to wait.

outcomes.text: It carries your heaviest packs, humming, until it leaves you at the next fork, content.

options.label: The strongest smashes it for the metal inside.

outcomes.text: It does not want to be smashed.

options.label: The cleverest asks it about the forge and what its master made.

outcomes.text: It remembers where the master kept his best work.
